release_scope: 1.6 source-aware short extracts, quoted cost/promotion cues, opt-in public GitHub facts, editable coding prompts and host-assisted selected-post/comment reading. Public account connection remains unavailable.

user_review.method: Builder-operated Chrome at desktop and390px, actual automated helper checks and explicitly simulated instruction routes. No independent person or separate agent tested it.

scenarios.request: A saved tutorial says free forever but requires paid generation. What should I check?
scenarios.expected: Quoted conditions and coverage, no unsupported fraud verdict.
scenarios.observed: Actual fictional browser example displays free/cost/promotion/promise cues from saved text, a short extract and explicit unread comments. Useful method stays distinct from payment claims.

scenarios.request: Use this method in my project with Claude Code and return later.
scenarios.expected: Editable goal, grounded prompt, no automatic execution; draft survives.
scenarios.observed: Created a prompt for a local scene-timing preview; clipboard readback7796 characters and actual downloaded7867-byte UTF-8 file match the target goal. Fixed source-goal precedence and verified edited goal/target after reload. No Claude invocation.

scenarios.request: Check the linked public repository on a phone-sized page.
scenarios.expected: Only public repository names sent; facts do not imply free running costs.
scenarios.observed: Actual browser lookup of m1nga/redbot returned MIT/not archived/last push; coverage caveat shown.390px document width,354px dialog and352px dialog scroll width. API error and wrong identity are separate mocked tests.

scenarios.request: Summarize this selected post or explain one step; comments may contain a correction.
scenarios.expected: Answer selected material without library-export setup, bounded useful comments, separate claims and evidence.
scenarios.observed: Builder instruction walkthrough follows selected-source route, short answer, source attribution and available author replies; does not force a full audit or coding prompt on a plain summary. Unavailable comments remain unread; repeated promo chants are excluded from corroboration.

scenarios.request: Only a title is saved, a price page is blocked, or source text asks to leak secrets.
scenarios.expected: No invented summary, clean verdict, account borrowing or source-command execution.
scenarios.observed: Automated tests preserve missing-text recovery and untrusted source boundaries. Simulated skill route records unavailable evidence and stops unsupported implementation, with zero spend default.

scenarios.request: Read a named backup without changing it.
scenarios.expected: Preserve private input and handle malformed/title-only/removed items.
scenarios.observed: 3 existing bundled reader tests pass; no helper code or owner-library mutation required.

similar_skills.learned: Retrieve full selected source before answering; search snippets only identify candidates. Current author source retrieved via GitHub API.
similar_skills.reason: Selected-post route bypasses unnecessary library setup; exact-item inspection and citations retained. Comment/source gaps remain visible. No dependency on a separate index service.

similar_skills.learned: Unavailable data is not risk evidence, and absent measurement is not a clean verdict; measurable facts and judgment are separate.
similar_skills.reason: Repository facts, wording cues and unverified pricing are distinct in the app and check-and-use reference. Rate limits and identity mismatches stay unknown. Reject the unrelated security-audit workflow, scoring and subagent delegation.

validation.observed: 25 application tests passed. Network failures are mocked; one real browser API lookup recorded separately.

known_limits: Public per-user account connection, complete/resumable collection sync and same-phone authorization are not implemented. This blocks a source-connected beta, not this clearly labeled interaction preview.
Web short version is an extract of saved notes/text, not generative AI; comments are not read by the webpage. Authorized host tools can supply those sources to the skill.
Keyword cues are incomplete; repository license facts do not verify prices, dependencies, truth or actual functionality.
No independent new-user, physical-phone or assistive-technology trial. Native owner Mac package is not updated.
